title: Jeremiah's Personal Lament and God's Promise
description: The prophet Jeremiah expresses his deep pain and loneliness to God, asking why his wound is not healed. God responds with a call to repentance and a promise to make the prophet an unyielding bronze wall that cannot be overcome, and to deliver him from the hand of the wicked [ref:Jer 15:10-21|Jeremiah 15:10-21].
